topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 36 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs, 1 Chainlink feed; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (badgev1, proxysetter, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
